title: Leen and the madd letters: soft sounds: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Infitar, ghunnah and the sifat in practice
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 33 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Leen and the madd letters rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 33. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Madd letters and leen letters
points: Madd: ا after fathah, و after dammah, ي after kasrah
Leen: و or ي with sukoon after a fathah
Leen is soft and natural; it lengthens only when we stop on the next letter

keywords.def: a soft waw or yaa with sukoon after a fathah
the qualities of the letters (whispered, strong, heavy and so on)

questions.q: Read Quraysh 106:3 to 4, stopping on «ٱلْبَيْتِ» and «خَوْفٍۭ» with the same leen length.
questions.a: rabba haadhal-bayt (leen) ... min khawf (leen), same count.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: sort twelve words into madd letter or leen letter. Today's rota group recites Al-Infitar 1 to 8.
questions.a: Madd: تُكَذِّبُونَ, يَعْلَمُونَ ...; leen: يَوْمَ, ٱلْبَيْتِ, خَوْفٍۭ ...

questions.q: Extend: find a leen letter in 82:19.
questions.a: «شَيْـًٔا» and «يَوْمَ» (the yaa and the waw after a fathah).

questions.q: Stretch: why does leen only lengthen when we stop?
questions.a: When joined there is nothing to lengthen it; stopping adds a sukoon after it, like madd 'aarid.

options: و or ي with sukoon after a fathah
questions.a: A) و or ي with sukoon after a fathah. Leen: soft waw or yaa after a fathah.

questions.q: Think again: «يَوْمَ» and «يَقُولُ» both have a waw. Why does one sound soft and short while the other is long?
questions.a: In «يَوْمَ» the waw is sakin after a fathah: leen (soft). In «يَقُولُ» it is sakin after a dammah: a madd letter.
